text: there is one in the asset explorer that if you are too far right it renders under the stage [Image #1]
resolution: Moved the asset explorer's model action menu out of LibraryPanel's clipped containing block and into AppFrame's late app-root overlay layer. Tree rows and model thumbnails now forward the target model plus window-space right-click coordinates; rename/favorite/duplicate/delete still use the existing AppFrame actions, while the shared viewport flip/clamp behavior from req_3829 applies at the correct root. ReleaseFast editor ship and all six context-menu placement regressions pass.
